product_constraint: 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode with exact state/logits/output, d2/d3 and joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total reporting

downward_budget.scope: Measured whole-API family opportunity, not a prediction for a cache hint.

mechanism: Explicit native cache-prefetch requests warm one next K1024 block of weights and all M activation records. Demand loads and all arithmetic remain original. Unlike v51, no extra live operand registers can be folded back to the consumer; final SASS must contain cache-prefetch instructions before current FMA.

isa_reference.scope: Performance hint only; no correctness dependency or guaranteed cache hit/latency overlap. No source imported.

equivalence_ledger: Only prefetch valid next-record addresses when base+1024<k; no out-of-range tail hint.
All original demand loads, quantized decode, scalar FP32 FMA chains, reduction order, final scale and BF16 publication retained.
No arithmetic or numerical fallback depends on whether the cache hint is honored.
No shared or global allocation, expanded representation, state or Prefill changes.
resource_contract: Original 256-thread/4-output grids and table; preserve M2/M3/M4 register block floors4/3/2 with fixed launch bounds. Reject spills at static gate.
gates: exact compiled server contains early native prefetch and no spills
complete FP8 output/guard cases plus full P65 prefix/cache/transaction checks
immediate same P65/8K/40K d2 API; >3% slowdown stops, neutral removes; useful direction unlocks d3
expiry: Remove at failed gate or first negative/neutral API; useful direction is bounded next-verifier dependency, not production promotion. No prefetch distance/cache-level scan.
